contract: Keep actual sender and two fixed GET targets; hard throw before all DB work; report only allowlisted bounded integer error codes/subcodes and a boolean transient flag. No raw error messages, trace identifiers, response URLs, credential values, additional network targets, provider POSTs or automatic retries.

red.test: sender preflight reports only bounded numeric provider error metadata
red.reason: Expected numeric metadata absent; prior output contained only operation and HTTP status.

limits: All new tests use injected transport and synthetic values, not live Meta credentials
Focused cases cover numeric whitelist, invalid types/ranges, oversized JSON and an 8-second stalled stream
This change cannot itself authorize the missing test-account access

browserLimitation: Automatic approval review blocked Meta UI observation after private credential handoff; no alternate browser route was attempted after that rejection.
